description: Cline, Continue and Kilo Code installed as npm globals on Windows, found by package name.
why: The npm route on Windows for the three CLIs 20-cli-agents and 71-linux-cli-agents prove on macOS and Linux. Each package is the only witness for its agent here. `forbid` names Claude Code, whose extension id Cline's carries, and Roo Code, the fork Kilo Code descends from.
known_gaps: Installed, never run: none of the three creates a state directory here.
